races.paceDynamic: Escape Plan is the sole committed front runner and will dictate terms from the gates, likely getting an uncontested lead with the prominent runners Eightthreeone, Viking Glory and Our Guy settling just behind. The large contingent of hold-up horses (Adalida, Medyg, Nebbia, Madman, Yes Waliim, Footstepinthewoods, Uniter, Sun Of Dolly) will create traffic problems in the rear half of the field over this sharp 6f at Windsor. With minimal early pace pressure on Escape Plan and so many closers needing room, this race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can secure clear running positions early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Escape Plan gets soft fractions without early pressure
scenarios.body: Tom Marquand can dictate his own pace and kick clear when the closers are still fighting for racing room in behind. The packed field of hold-up horses will struggle to make up significant ground over this short straight.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace setters duel or tire in the final furlong
scenarios.body: Eightthreeone or Viking Glory can pounce from their tracking positions with clear runs while the hold-up horses are still threading through traffic. Their prominent style gives them the tactical advantage over this course.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up Horse Gets Lucky
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and gaps appear late
scenarios.body: One of the better hold-up horses like Adalida or Madman finds the perfect split to exploit tired leaders. This requires significant pace collapse and fortune with traffic, making it the least likely outcome.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Finish Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses interfere or the race becomes a cavalry charge
scenarios.body: The tight finish creates opportunities for an unconsidered runner like Forever Glamorous to sneak through on the rail. Traffic problems can level the playing field when positioned runners get stopped.

watchPoints.text: Escape Plan getting away with soft fractions early - if uncontested he becomes very hard to peg back
Traffic problems developing in the back half where most of the field will be positioned turning for home
Viking Glory's fitness after 115-day break - any signs of needing the run would boost the front runners
Draw bias at Windsor - horses drawn low may get better positions on the rail in the straight
Forever Glamorous dropping significantly in class and weight - could outrun her odds if getting a clear run

races.paceDynamic: The Anthony Gover will get an uncontested lead with no other dedicated front-runners in the field. Six prominent runners (Decade Of Time, Heraldry, Mostaan, Windbreaker, Symphony's Song, Eagles Attire, Big Eagle) will create significant congestion behind the leader through the middle stages. This bottleneck will intensify approaching the home turn as they all vie for position. The clear pace scenario strongly favours hold-up horses like Bemersyde and Thomas Picton who can avoid the traffic and deliver late challenges, plus the two unexposed newcomers Kahin and Turret if they settle off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Benefit
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent group creates the expected traffic jam approaching the home turn
scenarios.body: The pace collapses as congested runners check each other's momentum, allowing patient hold-up horses to sweep through with clear runs. Bemersyde and the newcomers Kahin/Turret benefit most from this tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Two Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If The Anthony Gover maintains his lead and one prominent runner breaks clear early
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader kicks away while one of the classier prominent runners (Heraldry or Big Eagle) gets first run on the field. The pace becomes genuine enough to hold off late challengers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Group Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners sort themselves out without serious interference
scenarios.body: The large prominent group manages to spread out effectively, with the best horse among them (Big Eagle or Heraldry) asserting superiority. Traffic clears sufficiently to prevent late swoops from being decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If The Anthony Gover stops quickly and the prominent group bunches severely
scenarios.body: The leader folds and the congested group behind creates a cavalry charge finish where any horse getting a clear run can win. The race becomes a lottery favouring whoever gets the clearest passage.

watchPoints.text: The Anthony Gover could get such an easy lead that he builds an unassailable advantage before the prominent group reacts

races.paceDynamic: Crazee Icon is the sole natural front-runner and will dictate terms from the front without pressure, likely setting a sustainable gallop through moderate early fractions. The prominent group of Tamzan, Upsomdowns, Eyes Front, Tough Date, and La Peregrina will track closely behind, while hold-up specialists Jamie Sommers, Pepper Fizz, Legacy Rock, and Tinsel will be positioned towards the rear. With only one pace-setter and a sizeable field of tracker types, this creates a compressed race where the tempo may lack bite until the final quarter-mile. This tactical setup strongly favours the hold-up horses who can exploit the lack of early pace and finish powerfully from off the tempo.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominant
scenarios.trigger: If Crazee Icon sets modest fractions and the prominent group fails to apply pressure
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2f pole where hold-up horses can unleash their finishing kicks against rivals who've been racing keenly throughout. Jamie Sommers and Legacy Rock are perfectly positioned to exploit this tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent group applies more pressure to Crazee Icon than expected, creating stronger gallop
scenarios.body: This increased tempo stretches the field and prevents the hold-up horses from closing effectively in the final furlong. Eyes Front and Upsomdowns can capitalise on their handy positions without being outkicked.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Crazee Icon gets easy fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows the leader to build an unassailable advantage while the field remains bunched behind arguing amongst themselves. Crazee Icon's class edge becomes decisive when given such tactical luxury.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If the tempo becomes pedestrian throughout with no horse willing to commit until very late
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy cavalry charge where positioning and luck matter more than running style. Any horse with a clear run can capitalise regardless of their preferred tactics.

scenarios.title: Bold Impact Dictates Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If the leader gets completely his own way and kicks clear turning in

races.paceDynamic: Overbudget, Blue Deveron, Queen Sana and Mehmas Engine will ensure a breakneck gallop from the start over this minimum trip. With four confirmed front-runners in an 11-runner field, the early pace will be suicidal as they clash for the lead through the opening two furlongs. This creates perfect conditions for hold-up horses like Filly Foden and Stock Market to close late, while the prominent racers such as Too Darn Good and Staniel Cay can track the pace and strike when the leaders tire. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and late-closing prominent racers who can capitalize on the inevitable pace collapse.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leaders Burn Out Early
scenarios.trigger: If the four front-runners engage in a pace duel through the first half-mile
scenarios.body: The early gallop becomes unsustainable and the leaders compound badly in the final furlong. Hold-up horses like Filly Foden get the perfect setup to sweep past tired leaders, while Stock Market can also benefit despite his finishing concerns over this shorter trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Splits Field Apart
scenarios.trigger: If one leader gets a slight advantage and the others chase hard
scenarios.body: The race becomes a straight speed test with the field strung out behind the battling front four. Queen Sana or Blue Deveron could prove toughest of the leaders if they can handle the pressure, while prominent racers get pulled into the pace battle.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Battle
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runners go steadier than expected early on
scenarios.body: The pace becomes more tactical but still solid, allowing the prominent horses to get closer to the leaders. Coyy and Too Darn Good can position perfectly to strike when the sprint begins, while the hold-up horses may find less pace collapse to exploit.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If one leader breaks clear early and the others fade quickly
scenarios.body: Overbudget or Queen Sana gets an uncontested lead and has enough left to hold off the closers. The remaining pace horses compound badly, leaving just one strong leader to fend off the late challenge from the back markers.

watchPoints.text: Stock Market fading in the final 50 yards despite getting perfect pace setup, as his stamina limitations may still surface
Overbudget and Blue Deveron fighting for the early lead, as whichever gets headed first will likely compound badly
Too Darn Good's positioning in the first furlong after his long break, as he needs to avoid getting pulled into the pace battle
Mehmas Engine's jumping and settling, as his headgear suggests connections are concerned about his racing manners

scenarios.trigger: If Zhang Fei gets an uncontested lead while Gone Rogue settles behind rivals
scenarios.body: The Fergal O'Brien runner gets first run on Gone Rogue and kicks clear before the hold-up horses can organize their challenge. The strong pace suits his front-running style perfectly over this staying trip.

watchPoints.text: Gone Rogue and Zhang Fei could set fractions too strong if they engage in early battle, compromising both front-runners' chances.
Six hold-up horses bunching together turning for home will create severe traffic problems and eliminate several chances.
Fast Steps' ability to get competitive position early will be crucial given the lack of other prominent racers behind the leaders.
Zhang Fei's fitness after 224-day absence under conditional jockey Gina Mangan in competitive handicap company.
Blackwaterfoot's sharp early speed from hold-up position could help him avoid the inevitable traffic issues developing behind.
